name: Tinker: Replenishment Beacon applies its field buff (#10101)
contract: Build: Replenishment Beacon 560750 summons creature 500360 for 15 sec and restores 5% base mana plus
rage/energy/focus/runic power every 2.5 sec to the Tinker and grouped allies within 10 yd. Its spell
description promises a force field, but the beacon applied no aura, so affected allies saw no buff. The
authored field aura is 560765 'Beacon Replenishment' (persistent-area-aura in client data); the server
converts it to an ally aura and the beacon now applies it to every player it restores, refreshing it each
tick. Expected: the Tinker and a grouped ally carry aura 560765 while inside the field, an ungrouped
player inside the same radius does not, the base-mana restore still fires once per tick through 561267,
and the 15 sec field aura itself never ticks (it is re-applied with a 2.4 sec duration each tick).

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the Tinker carries the field buff
The grouped ally carries the field buff
The ungrouped player gets no field buff
The base-mana restore still fires for the Tinker
The base-mana restore still fires for the ally
The field aura itself restores nothing
The buff is kept refreshed while the beacon lasts
